subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Benefis Hospitals have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Benefis Health System hospital reports more; Missouri River Medical Center is next at 64. About 8.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Missouri River Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals has the most, 2,691. About 2.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Benefis Teton Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals has the most, 2,691. About 2.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Benefis Health System's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: What percent of Benefis Hospitals's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Benefis Health System hospital runs higher; Benefis Teton Medical Center is next at 5 percent. Traditional Medicare was 32 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 16 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Missouri River Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals runs highest, 48 percent. Traditional Medicare was 5 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Benefis Teton Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals runs highest, 48 percent. Traditional Medicare was 5 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Benefis Hospitals's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 26 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Benefis Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Benefis Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Benefis Hospitals report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: No other Benefis Health System hospital reports more; Missouri River Medical Center is next at 25 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Missouri River Medical Center report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals has the most, 312 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Benefis Teton Medical Center report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Benefis Hospitals has the most, 312 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Benefis Hospitals report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is 14 percent of its 312 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Benefis Hospitals report for 2024?
questions.why: About 32 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Benefis Hospitals in 2024?
questions.why: Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Benefis Hospitals's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That is the emptiest of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Missouri River Medical Center ran fullest, 89 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Missouri River Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: No other Benefis Health System hospital ran fuller; Benefis Teton Medical Center is next at 80 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Benefis Teton Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Benefis Health System hospitals; Missouri River Medical Center ran fullest, 89 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Benefis Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Montana. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of Benefis Health System's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Benefis Teton Medical Center and Missouri River Medical Center.

questions.q: How many of Benefis Health System's hospitals are outside a metropolitan area?
questions.why: They are Benefis Teton Medical Center and Missouri River Medical Center.

questions.q: How many beds do Benefis Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many beds does Benefis Health System's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Benefis Hospitals. Missouri River Medical Center is next, with 25.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Benefis Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 12 percent of their 362 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Benefis Health System's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 32 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
